title: Count the vowels
prompt:
Write `count_vowels` that counts the vowels `a e i o u` in a piece of text. Upper and lower case both count.

```text
count_vowels("hello") -> 2
count_vowels("RUST")  -> 1
count_vowels("xyz")   -> 0
```

Signature: `def count_vowels(s):`

run.template:
{{code}}

print(count_vowels('hello'))
print(count_vowels('RUST'))
print(count_vowels('xyz'))
print(count_vowels(''))
print(count_vowels('Programming is fun'))

hints: Go through the text one character at a time.
Convert each character to lower case first, so you only have to compare with five letters.
Keep a counter and add 1 whenever the character is one of `a e i o u`.
explanation: Lower-casing each character first means one comparison covers both cases. A counter that grows only for vowels gives the total.
